title: Eval shard dispatch
description: repository_dispatch client_payload for one evaluation shard. Version 1.1 keeps only the eight fields the job needs before it starts (schema_version, eval_run_id, shard_id, attempt, dispatch_key, manifest_url, runs_on, job_timeout_minutes); manifest_digest, expires_at and the scripts bundle pin are served by the shard manifest response and the /scripts metadata endpoint after the job starts. Version 1.0 (digest and expiry in the payload, at most ten properties) stays accepted for dispatches created before the rollout. It never carries cases, prompts, model keys or cloud credentials.

manifest_digest.description: Version 1.0 only: the manifest digest is now returned by the shard manifest response (X-Manifest-Digest).

expires_at.description: Version 1.0 only: the dispatch expiry is now returned by the shard manifest response (X-Manifest-Expires-At).

job_timeout_minutes.description: GitHub execute job timeout derived from the frozen case budget. Required in 1.1; optional for 1.0 dispatches created before #304, where the workflow falls back to 60 minutes.

oneOf.description: Version 1.0: legacy dispatch with the manifest digest and expiry frozen in the payload.
Version 1.1: minimal dispatch; digest, expiry and the scripts bundle pin come from the server descriptor after the job starts.
